name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Georgian Cabin Sauna w/ Changeroom 6 Person | CTC88CW
description: Description This Canadian Timber Georgian Cabin Sauna is handcrafted from Eastern White Cedar, this sauna is strong for all-weather outdoor use, resistant to rot and decay, and features a beautiful light-colored finish. The door is 0.2 in ( 5mm) bronze tempered glass with a wooden frame and pre-hung on the front wall for easy installation. This sauna comes packaged in a ready-to-assemble kit . It features a 2-level L-shaped bench for up to 6-person seating and 2 front windows & 2 door windows to enjoy the view outside. This special sauna includes a separate changing room, so you can get ready for your sauna session in privacy. Features: Seats: 2-6 people in the sauna and up to 4 more in changing room Outside Dimensions incl roof: 8.2' wide x 12.1' long x 8.4' tall at peak Interior Dimensions: 7'W x 11'L x 7'H (353 cu ft sauna section - 539 cu ft total) Wood: Eastern White Cedar Walls: 1.5" thick solid Cedar Door: Full-Sized Door with Bronze-Tempered Window for Easy Access Windows: 2 double paned bronze-tempered windows Weight: 2,624 lbs Shipping Dimensions: 144" x 45" x 44" Made in: Canada Recommended Heater: 8 kW electric heater or wood-burning sauna stove Delivery: Free Delivery Curbside: customer responsibility to offload crate from truck via forklift with fork extensions or hand offloading if allowed by trucking company. The Dundalk Georgian is also available in the following configurations: Dundalk Georgian without Changeroom Dundalk Georgian with Porch Dimensions CTC88CW - Product Drawing Assembly Installation Manual Dundalk Shipping Policy Included Includes: Full sauna kit: Pre-cut tongue & groove white cedar for full sauna structure Prefab 2-tier solid benches with bottom L bench in sauna and 2 benches in changeroom 2x Bronze tempered glass windows Cedar roof boards Premium metal shingle roof 2x Doors w/ bronze tempered glass windows Hardware Installation guide & video Heater sold separately Choose a matched heater package in the heater options on this page, or contact us if you'd like a different heater. Sauna Accessories Add a Cold Plunge Tub , Outdoor Shower , Backrests , Bucket & Ladle , Lights , Thermometer , and Sand Timer to create the ultimate relaxation haven.
